description: image_transcribe response for image 007936749_00008 — the Thomas Flynn will page in the unindexed Schuylkill County probate volume. The `imageId` predicate is anchored to the FULL id (a real page in image-search-schuylkill-probate's 15-image list). Keep it film-anchored: `~` is an unanchored substring match (fixtures.py) and the first matching fixture wins in declaration order (mock_mcp.py), so a bare `~00008` also matched `007936752_00008` and `008116090_00008` — serving this 1889 will on the 1891-1930 film and on the mixed-items film, in both cases contradicting those tests' own judge_context (#2753 review). Added with the search-images pair conversion (issue #2121): the agent now OCRs pages itself rather than delegating to @plugin:image-reader, and a call to a tool with no loaded fixture ABORTS the run (unmatched_tool_call, unit-test-spec §5.3) — so the browse is unrunnable without this. Pair it with image-transcribe-any, ordered LAST, so stepping to a neighbouring page degrades gracefully instead of aborting.

response.transcription:
Will Book G, page 112. Schuylkill County, Pennsylvania.

In the name of God, Amen. I, THOMAS FLYNN, of the Borough of Minersville in the County of Schuylkill and State of Pennsylvania, being weak in body but of sound mind, memory and understanding, do make and publish this my last Will and Testament.

Item. I give and bequeath unto my beloved wife MARGARET FLYNN the dwelling house and lot whereon I now reside, for and during the term of her natural life.

Item. I give unto my son JOHN FLYNN the sum of one hundred dollars.

Item. I give unto my daughter MARY ANN DOUGHERTY, wife of Patrick Dougherty, the sum of one hundred dollars.

Item. The residue of my estate I direct to be sold and divided equally among my children aforesaid.

I appoint my wife Margaret Flynn and my friend JAMES CONNELL executors of this my last Will.

In witness whereof I have hereunto set my hand and seal this fourteenth day of March, A.D. 1889.

                                        Thomas [his X mark] Flynn  (seal)

Signed, sealed and published in presence of:
  Bernard McGinley
  Owen Brennan

Proved and letters testamentary granted 2nd April 1889.
